patch: UPDATE tax_returns SET federal_refund_amount = 100.00, state_refund_amount = 50.00 WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2023 AND lower(status) = 'filed'
UPDATE tax_returns SET federal_refund_amount = 200.00, state_refund_amount = 50.00 WHERE user_email = :email AND tax_year = 2024 AND lower(status) = 'filed'
probe: SELECT id, tax_year, status, federal_refund_amount, state_refund_amount, (federal_refund_amount + state_refund_amount) AS combined FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email ORDER BY tax_year

extra_probes_before.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_filed, SUM(federal_refund_amount + state_refund_amount) AS combined_refund FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND lower(status) = 'filed' AND tax_year < COALESCE((SELECT MIN(tax_year) FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND lower(status) != 'filed'), (SELECT MAX(tax_year) + 1 FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email))

extra_probes_after.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n_filed, SUM(federal_refund_amount + state_refund_amount) AS combined_refund FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND lower(status) = 'filed' AND tax_year < COALESCE((SELECT MIN(tax_year) FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email AND lower(status) != 'filed'), (SELECT MAX(tax_year) + 1 FROM tax_returns WHERE user_email = :email))
